dialogs.title: At the check-in counter
dialogs.goal: 练习护照/行李/座位相关表达，从容应对值机

lines.en: Good morning. May I see your passport and booking reference, please?
lines.zh: 早上好，请出示您的护照和预订编号。

lines.en: Sure, here you are. I'd like a window seat if possible.
lines.zh: 好的，给您。如果可以的话我想要靠窗的座位。

lines.en: I can arrange that. Are you checking in any bags today?
lines.zh: 可以安排。您今天有要托运的行李吗？

lines.en: Just one suitcase. Does it meet the weight limit?
lines.zh: 就一个行李箱。它超重了吗？

lines.en: It's within the limit. Your boarding pass is ready — gate 22, boarding at 10:40.
lines.zh: 在限额内。您的登机牌好了——22 号登机口，10:40 登机。

lines.en: Great. Could you also confirm that my carry-on bag fits the cabin size requirements?
lines.zh: 太好了。您能再确认一下我的随身行李符合客舱尺寸要求吗？

lines.en: Let me check the dimensions. Yes, it fits within our standard allowance. You're all set for the cabin.
lines.zh: 让我看一下尺寸。是的，符合我们的标准限额。您的客舱行李没问题。

lines.en: Perfect. By the way, is there any chance I could get an aisle seat instead? I just realized I may need to stretch my legs.
lines.zh: 太好了。顺便问一下，我能改成过道座位吗？我刚意识到可能需要伸伸腿。

lines.en: Certainly. Let me update that for you — I've moved you to 21C, an aisle seat. No problem at all.
lines.zh: 当然可以。我来为您更新——已为您调到21C，过道座位。完全没问题。

lines.en: Thank you so much. One last thing — what time should I be at the gate?
lines.zh: 非常感谢。最后问一下，我应该在什么时间到登机口？

lines.en: Please be at the gate at least 30 minutes before boarding. Enjoy your flight, and have a wonderful trip!
lines.zh: 请在登机前至少30分钟到达登机口。祝您飞行愉快，旅途顺利！

dialogs.title: Small talk at a conference
dialogs.goal: 用自然的破冰句开启商务对话，并过渡到合作话题

lines.en: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Echo, from the consumer insights team.
lines.zh: 你好，我们好像还没见过。我是 Echo，来自消费者洞察团队。

lines.en: Nice to meet you. I work on product strategy. What brings you to this session?
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你。我做产品策略。你为什么来听这场？

lines.en: I'm exploring how AI is changing our research methods. Have you seen anything useful today?
lines.zh: 我在研究 AI 如何改变我们的研究方法。你今天有看到什么有用的吗？

lines.en: Actually, yes — a talk on real-time consumer signals. We should compare notes sometime.
lines.zh: 其实有——一个关于实时消费者信号的演讲。我们应该找个时间交流一下。

lines.en: I'd love that. Let's grab coffee after the keynote.
lines.zh: 太好了。主题演讲后我们喝杯咖啡吧。

lines.en: Sounds good. By the way, how does your team currently handle qualitative data?
lines.zh: 听起来不错。顺便问一下，你们团队目前是怎么处理定性数据的？

lines.en: We still rely heavily on manual coding, which is time-consuming. That's why I'm keen on AI-driven tools.
lines.zh: 我们还是主要靠人工编码，很耗时。所以我对 AI 驱动的工具很感兴趣。

lines.en: Interesting. We've been piloting a sentiment analysis model that might complement your workflow.
lines.zh: 有意思。我们一直在试点一个情绪分析模型，可能和你们的工作流互补。

lines.en: That sounds promising. Could you share a bit more about how it handles multilingual data?
lines.zh: 听起来很有前景。你能多分享一下它如何处理多语言数据吗？

lines.en: Sure — it's trained on several major languages, but accuracy varies. Maybe we can set up a quick demo next week.
lines.zh: 当然——它在几种主要语言上训练过，但准确率有差异。也许我们下周可以安排一个快速演示。

lines.en: Perfect. I'll bring our research lead along. Let's exchange contacts and follow up by email.
lines.zh: 完美。我会带上我们的研究负责人。我们交换一下联系方式，然后邮件跟进吧。

dialogs.title: Checking into a hotel
dialogs.goal: 掌握入住登记、特殊需求与Wi-Fi等常用句

lines.en: Good evening. Do you have a reservation under the name Lee?
lines.zh: 晚上好。请问有预订在 Lee 名下吗？

lines.en: Yes, for two nights. Is breakfast included?
lines.zh: 有的，住两晚。含早餐吗？

lines.en: It is — served from 7 to 10. Could I have a room on a higher floor, away from the elevator?
lines.zh: 含的——7 点到 10 点供应。可以安排高一点、远离电梯的房间吗？

lines.en: Certainly. Here's your key card, and the Wi-Fi password is on this slip.
lines.zh: 当然可以。这是您的房卡，Wi-Fi 密码在这张纸上。

lines.en: Thank you. Could you also confirm the checkout time for me?
lines.zh: 谢谢。另外能帮我确认一下退房时间吗？

lines.en: Checkout is at noon, but we offer a late checkout until 2 PM for an additional fee.
lines.zh: 退房时间是中午12点，不过我们可以提供延迟至下午2点的退房服务，需额外收费。

lines.en: That's good to know. I might take advantage of that. Is there a gym or pool on site?
lines.zh: 这信息很有用，我可能会用到。酒店内有健身房或游泳池吗？

lines.en: Yes, both are on the second floor, open from 6 AM to 10 PM. Towels are provided at the front desk.
lines.zh: 有的，两者都在二楼，开放时间为早上6点到晚上10点。毛巾可在前台领取。

lines.en: Perfect. One more thing — could you arrange a wake-up call at 7:30 tomorrow morning?
lines.zh: 太好了。还有一件事——能帮我安排明早7:30的叫醒服务吗？

lines.en: Of course. I've noted that for room 1208. Is there anything else you need?
lines.zh: 当然可以。我已为您记录在1208房间。还有其他需要吗？

lines.en: No, that's all for now. Thanks for your help.
lines.zh: 暂时没有了，谢谢你的帮助。

dialogs.title: Ordering with dietary needs
dialogs.goal: 清晰表达过敏/忌口，避免误会

lines.en: Welcome! Have you decided what you'd like to order?
lines.zh: 欢迎！您决定好点什么了吗？

lines.en: Not yet. I'm allergic to peanuts — could you tell me which dishes are safe?
lines.zh: 还没。我对花生过敏——能告诉我哪些菜是安全的吗？

lines.en: Of course. The grilled fish and the vegetable soup are both nut-free. I'll note the allergy for the kitchen.
lines.zh: 当然。烤鱼和蔬菜汤都不含坚果。我会在厨房单上标注过敏。

lines.en: Perfect, thank you. Could I also get that without spicy sauce?
lines.zh: 太好了，谢谢。那份可以不放辣酱吗？

lines.en: Absolutely. I'll make sure the chef prepares it with a mild seasoning instead. Would you like any appetizer to start?
lines.zh: 完全可以。我会确保厨师改用清淡调味。需要先来点开胃菜吗？

lines.en: Yes, the spring rolls look good — but are they fried in peanut oil?
lines.zh: 好的，春卷看起来不错——但那是用花生油炸的吗？

lines.en: Good question. We use canola oil for frying, so they're safe. However, the dipping sauce contains sesame paste — would you like it on the side?
lines.zh: 问得好。我们用菜籽油炸，所以是安全的。不过蘸酱含芝麻酱——需要单独放旁边吗？

lines.en: That would be great. Please keep the sauce separate, and I'll decide whether to use it.
lines.zh: 那太好了。请把酱单独放，我自己决定要不要用。

lines.en: Understood. I'll also check with the kitchen on the dessert options — the mango pudding is peanut-free, but the chocolate cake may contain traces.
lines.zh: 明白了。我还会和厨房确认甜点选项——芒果布丁不含花生，但巧克力蛋糕可能含微量。

lines.en: Thanks for being so thorough. I'll go with the mango pudding then.
lines.zh: 谢谢你这么仔细。那我就选芒果布丁吧。

lines.en: Great choice. I'll place your order now and confirm everything with the chef. Your safety is our priority.
lines.zh: 好选择。我现在下单并和厨师确认所有细节。您的安全是我们的首要任务。

dialogs.title: Talking about AI at work
dialogs.goal: 用职场商务英语表达对 AI 的看法与担忧

lines.en: Have you tried the new AI assistant? It's been a game-changer for my drafts.
lines.zh: 你试过新的 AI 助手了吗？它彻底改变了我写草稿的方式。

lines.en: I have, but I'm cautious. I double-check everything it produces.
lines.zh: 试过，但我比较谨慎。它生成的东西我都会复核。

lines.en: Fair enough. I see it as a starting point, not the final answer.
lines.zh: 有道理。我把它当作起点，而不是最终答案。

lines.en: Exactly. The human touch still matters most with our clients.
lines.zh: 没错。对咱们的客户来说，人情味依然最重要。

lines.en: That said, I've noticed it saves me at least two hours a day on research and summarization.
lines.zh: 话虽如此，我注意到它每天至少帮我在研究和总结上省下两个小时。

lines.en: I can see that. But what about accuracy? I've caught it making subtle errors in data interpretation.
lines.zh: 这我能理解。但准确性呢？我抓到过它在数据解读上犯一些很细微的错误。

lines.en: I've seen that too. That's why I always cross-reference its output with our internal reports.
lines.zh: 我也遇到过。所以我才总是拿它生成的内容和咱们内部报告做交叉核对。

lines.en: Good practice. My concern is more about long-term dependency—are we losing our own analytical skills?
lines.zh: 好习惯。我更担心的是长期依赖——我们会不会失去自己的分析能力？

lines.en: That's a valid point. I try to use it as a tool, not a crutch. I still do the critical thinking myself.
lines.zh: 这点提得很对。我尽量把它当工具，而不是拐杖。关键思考还是我自己来。

lines.en: I think we need a team guideline on when and how to use AI, especially for client-facing documents.
lines.zh: 我觉得咱们需要一份团队指南，明确什么时候、怎么用 AI，尤其是面对客户的文档。

lines.en: Agreed. Let's bring that up in next week's meeting—maybe we can draft a policy together.
lines.zh: 同意。咱们下周会上提一下——也许可以一起起草一份规范。

dialogs.title: Briefing a Descriptive Panel
dialogs.zhTitle: 为描述性感官评价小组做导入简报
dialogs.goal: 掌握主持感官评价小组时的标准指令语言与"去引导化"表达。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone. Before we start, a quick reminder: we are not looking for whether you like the sample. We are looking for what you perceive.
lines.zh: 早上好。开始之前提醒一下：我们不是要知道你喜不喜欢这个样品，而是要知道你感知到了什么。

lines.en: So we should keep preference out of it entirely?
lines.zh: 所以我们要完全把偏好排除在外？

lines.en: Exactly. Intensity, not preference. If something is very sweet and you personally hate it, the score is still high.
lines.zh: 正是。评的是强度，不是喜好。如果某样东西很甜而你个人讨厌它，分数依然要打高。

lines.en: Understood. And the order of the samples?
lines.zh: 明白了。样品顺序呢？

lines.en: Balanced and randomised, as always. Please cleanse your palate with water and the unsalted cracker between each one, and wait ninety seconds.
lines.zh: 照例是平衡随机化的。每个样品之间请用清水和无盐饼干清口，并等待 90 秒。

lines.en: What if I pick up an attribute that is not on the ballot?
lines.zh: 如果我感知到一个评分表上没有的属性怎么办？

lines.en: Write it in the open field. Honestly, those are often the most useful lines on the whole sheet.
lines.zh: 写在开放栏里。说实话，那些往往是整张表上最有价值的内容。

lines.en: Should I try to match the vocabulary we agreed on in training?
lines.zh: 我需要尽量用我们培训时统一的词汇吗？

lines.en: Use the lexicon where it fits, but do not force it. A forced term hides more than it reveals.
lines.zh: 合适的地方就用词典里的术语，但别硬套。硬套的术语掩盖的比揭示的多。

lines.en: One last thing — no discussion during evaluation. We compare notes only in the debrief.
lines.zh: 最后一点——评价过程中不要交流。我们只在总结环节比对结果。

keys.zh: 评强度，不评偏好（感官分析第一原则）
平衡随机化（样品呈送设计）

dialogs.title: Presenting Findings the Client Did Not Want
dialogs.zhTitle: 汇报一个客户不想听到的结论
dialogs.goal: 练习在坏消息中保持专业与建设性的商务表达。

lines.en: So, bottom line — does the new formulation win?
lines.zh: 所以，直接说结论——新配方赢了吗？

lines.en: Not on the measure you asked about. But I would argue you were asking about the wrong measure.
lines.zh: 在你问的那个指标上没有。但我认为，你问的可能不是该问的那个指标。

lines.en: Go on.
lines.zh: 你说。

lines.en: Overall liking is flat — statistically indistinguishable. However, the new formulation scores significantly higher on perceived care and product quality cues.
lines.zh: 总体喜好度持平，统计上无差异。但新配方在"感知到的用心程度"和"品质线索"上显著更高。

lines.en: Does that translate into anything commercial?
lines.zh: 这能转化成商业结果吗？

lines.en: It correlates strongly with repurchase intent in this category. Liking predicts the first purchase; quality cues predict the fourth.
lines.zh: 在这个品类里，它与复购意向高度相关。喜好度预测第一次购买，品质线索预测第四次。

lines.en: That is a bolder claim than I expected from you.
lines.zh: 这比我预期的你会说的话要大胆。

lines.en: It is in the appendix with the regression. I would rather show you the uncomfortable version now than the comfortable one in six months.
lines.zh: 附录里有回归结果。我宁愿现在给你看那个不舒服的版本，也不想六个月后给你看那个舒服的版本。

lines.en: Fair. What would you do if this were your decision?
lines.zh: 有道理。如果是你来定，你会怎么做？

lines.en: Ship it, but rewrite the claim. You are selling reassurance, not novelty.
lines.zh: 上市，但改掉宣称。你卖的是安心感，不是新奇感。

dialogs.title: A Tight Connection
dialogs.goal: 掌握机场改签、行李与登机口相关的高频表达。

lines.en: Excuse me, my inbound flight was delayed and I have fifty minutes to make my connection. Will I be all right?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，我来程航班延误了，中转只剩 50 分钟。来得及吗？

lines.en: It is tight but doable. Are you checked through to your final destination?
lines.zh: 有点紧但可以。您的行李是直挂到终点的吗？

lines.en: Yes, my luggage is tagged all the way through. Do I need to clear security again?
lines.zh: 是的，行李直挂到底。我需要重新过安检吗？

lines.en: You will, at the transfer point. Follow the purple signs, and mention your connection time at the desk — they can fast-track you.
lines.zh: 需要，在中转处。跟着紫色指示牌走，在柜台说明您的中转时间，他们可以帮您走快速通道。

lines.en: That is a relief. And if I miss it, what are my options?
lines.zh: 那我就放心了。万一没赶上，我有什么选择？

lines.en: You would be rebooked on the next available flight at no charge, since the delay was ours.
lines.zh: 因为延误是我们造成的，您会被免费改签到下一个有位的航班。

lines.en: Could you note my seat preference now, just in case? Aisle, towards the front.
lines.zh: 能不能现在先记下我的座位偏好，以防万一？靠走道，靠前一点。

lines.en: Noted. Here is your boarding pass. Gate B22 — boarding closes twenty minutes before departure.
lines.zh: 记下了。这是您的登机牌。B22 登机口，起飞前 20 分钟停止登机。

lines.en: Thank you. One more thing — is there anywhere to grab a quick coffee on the way?
lines.zh: 谢谢。还有一件事——路上有地方能快速买杯咖啡吗？

lines.en: There is a kiosk right past security. Honestly, with fifty minutes, I would skip it.
lines.zh: 过了安检就有个小店。不过说实话，只有 50 分钟的话，我建议您别去了。

dialogs.title: Explaining What You Do at a Dinner Party
dialogs.zhTitle: 在饭局上解释你到底是做什么的
dialogs.goal: 练习用非专业语言介绍专业工作，这是最难也最有用的能力。

lines.en: So what do you actually do? Something with market research?
lines.zh: 你到底是做什么的？跟市场调研有关？

lines.en: Sort of. I work on how products feel — taste, texture, smell — and why people prefer one over another.
lines.zh: 算是吧。我研究产品给人的感受——味道、质地、气味——以及人们为什么更偏爱其中一个。

lines.en: Wait, that is a real job? Who pays for that?
lines.zh: 等等，这是个真实存在的职业？谁会为这个付钱？

lines.en: Anyone who makes something you put in your mouth or on your skin. If two products cost the same, the one that feels right wins.
lines.zh: 任何做入口或上脸产品的公司。两个产品价格一样，感觉对的那个就赢了。

lines.en: Give me an example.
lines.zh: 举个例子。

lines.en: Sure. Think about the sound a jar makes when you first open it. That pop is engineered, and it makes the food taste fresher.
lines.zh: 好。想想第一次拧开一个罐子时的声音。那声"啵"是设计出来的，它会让食物尝起来更新鲜。

lines.en: You are telling me I have been manipulated by a lid.
lines.zh: 你是说我一直在被一个盖子操纵。

lines.en: I would say informed by a lid. Your brain uses every clue it can get, and sound is a very cheap clue.
lines.zh: 我会说是被一个盖子"告知"了。你的大脑会用上一切能拿到的线索，而声音是最廉价的一种。

lines.en: Does knowing all this ruin it for you?
lines.zh: 知道这些会不会让你失去乐趣？

lines.en: Occasionally. But mostly it does the opposite — it turns an ordinary Tuesday breakfast into something worth paying attention to.
lines.zh: 偶尔会。但大多数时候是反过来的——它让一个普通周二的早餐变成值得留意的东西。

keys.en: the one that feels right wins

keys.zh: 被操纵 / 被告知（一组有分寸感的对比）

dialogs.title: Pushing Back on an Impossible Timeline
dialogs.zhTitle: 拒绝一个不可能的排期
dialogs.goal: 练习职场中"有边界感但不对抗"的英文表达。

lines.en: We need the consumer test results by the fifteenth. Can you make that work?
lines.zh: 我们需要在 15 号前拿到消费者测试结果。你能做到吗？

lines.en: Let me walk you through what fifteenth would require, and then you can decide.
lines.zh: 我先带你过一遍 15 号意味着什么，然后你来决定。

lines.en: Okay.
lines.zh: 好。

lines.en: Recruitment alone is eight working days for this profile. That leaves two days for fieldwork and one for analysis.
lines.zh: 光是招募��类人群就要 8 个工作日。剩下 2 天做执行，1 天做分析。

lines.en: Could we shorten recruitment?
lines.zh: 招募能压缩吗？

lines.en: We could, but then we take whoever is available, and 'whoever is available' is a real bias, not a rounding error.
lines.zh: 可以，但那样我们只能要"谁有空要谁"，而"谁有空"是一个真实的偏差，不是舍入误差。

lines.en: What would you propose?
lines.zh: 你的建议是？

lines.en: Two options. A directional read on the fifteenth with a clear health warning, or a defensible result on the twenty-second.
lines.zh: 两个选项。15 号给一个方向性判断，并附明确的局限说明；或者 22 号给一个经得起挑战的结论。

lines.en: The steering committee meets on the eighteenth.
lines.zh: 指导委员会 18 号开会。

lines.en: Then take the directional read, and let me write the caveat slide myself. If someone quotes it out of context in a board deck, we both pay for it.
lines.zh: 那就用方向性判断，但局限说明那页让我自己写。如果有人把它断章取义放进董事会材料，我们两个都要付代价。

lines.en: Deal.
lines.zh: 成交。

keys.zh: 方向性判断（非定论性结论）
不是可以忽略的小误差

dialogs.title: A Room With a Problem
dialogs.goal: 练习礼貌而坚定的投诉与协商。

lines.en: Hi, I checked in about an hour ago into 704. I am afraid the room is not going to work.
lines.zh: 你好，我大约一小时前入住 704。恐怕这个房间不太行。

lines.en: I am sorry to hear that. May I ask what the issue is?
lines.zh: 很抱歉。方便问一下是什么问题吗？

lines.en: There is a persistent smell of damp, and the air conditioning is quite loud. I have an early start tomorrow.
lines.zh: 有一股持续的潮味，空调也挺吵。我明天要早起。

lines.en: Let me see what else we have. We are fairly full tonight.
lines.zh: 我看看还有什么房。今晚我们几乎满房。

lines.en: I appreciate that. I am not asking for an upgrade — just somewhere quiet and dry.
lines.zh: 我理解。我不是要求升级——只想要一个安静干燥的房间。

lines.en: I can offer you 1102. It is a similar layout, higher floor, away from the lift shaft.
lines.zh: 我可以给您 1102。户型相近，楼层更高，远离电梯井。

lines.en: That sounds much better. Could someone help me move the bags?
lines.zh: 那好多了。能安排人帮我搬一下行李吗？

lines.en: Of course. And I will note a late checkout on your booking for the inconvenience.
lines.zh: 当然。另外我会在您的订单上备注延迟退房，作为对不便的补偿。

lines.en: That is very kind — thank you for sorting it out so quickly.
lines.zh: 太贴心了——谢谢你这么快就处理好。

lines.en: You are most welcome. I will have the bellman bring up your new key shortly.
lines.zh: 不客气。我会让行李员马上把新房卡送上去。

lines.en: Perfect. I will head up now and get settled. Thanks again for your help.
lines.zh: 太好了。我现在就上去安顿。再次感谢你的帮助。

keys.en: I am not asking for an upgrade
keys.zh: 我并不是要求升级（降低对抗感）

dialogs.title: Small Talk at a Conference Coffee Break
dialogs.zhTitle: 会议茶歇上的专业闲聊
dialogs.goal: 练习从寒暄自然过渡到有价值的专业交流。

lines.en: That last session was a bit of a sales pitch, was it not?
lines.zh: 刚那场基本就是个推销吧？

lines.en: A little. Though the bit about implicit measurement was worth staying for.
lines.zh: 有一点。不过关于内隐测量的那一段还是值得留下来听的。

lines.en: Are you on the client side or agency?
lines.zh: 你是甲方还是乙方？

lines.en: Client side — I look after sensory and consumer insights for a personal care portfolio.
lines.zh: 甲方——我负责一个个护品类组合的感官与消费者洞察。

lines.en: Then you must be dealing with the AI question constantly.
lines.zh: 那你肯定天天在面对 AI 那个问题。

lines.en: Constantly. My working position is that AI is excellent before fieldwork and dangerous after it.
lines.zh: 天天。我目前的立场是：AI 在田野之前很好用，在田野之后很危险。

lines.en: That is a neat way of putting it. Where do you draw the line exactly?
lines.zh: 这个说法很精炼。你具体在哪里划这条线？

lines.en: Anything that generates hypotheses, yes. Anything that generates respondents, no.
lines.zh: 任何用来生成假设的，可以。任何用来生成受访者的，不行。

lines.en: I might steal that for my next steering group.
lines.zh: 我下次开指导会可能要借用一下这句。

lines.en: Please do. Are you around for the afternoon panel? I would be curious what you make of it.
lines.zh: 尽管用。你下午的圆桌还在吗？我挺想听听你怎么看。

keys.en: a bit of a sales pitch
where do you draw the line

dialogs.title: Moderating a Focus Group
dialogs.zhTitle: 主持一场焦点小组访谈
dialogs.goal: 练习在焦点小组中保持中立、追问而不引导、妥善处理冷场与分歧。

lines.en: Let's start simple — when you first tasted this, what was the very first thing that came to mind?
lines.zh: 咱们从简单处开始——你第一口尝到时，最先冒出来的念头是什么？

lines.en: It felt… clean? Like, not heavy on the tongue.
lines.zh: 感觉……很干净？就是说，舌头上不厚重。

lines.en: Clean — can you stay with that word for a second? What makes it feel clean versus, say, watery?
lines.zh: “干净”——你能就这个词再多说一点吗？它和所谓“寡淡”的区别在哪？

lines.en: For me clean means no aftertaste. Watery would be thin and forgettable.
lines.zh: 对我来说干净就是没有余味。寡淡则是单薄、喝完就忘了。

lines.en: Good distinction. Anyone feel something different in the aftertaste?
lines.zh: 这个区分很好。有人对余味有不同感受吗？

lines.en: There's a slight bitterness at the end. Not bad, just… present.
lines.zh: 尾段有一点苦。不讨厌，就是……存在感。

lines.en: Noted — a late bitterness. And does that bitterness make you want to take another sip, or stop?
lines.zh: 记下了——尾段苦。这种苦是让你想再喝一口，还是想停下？

lines.en: Actually it makes me curious. I'd go again.
lines.zh: 其实它让我有点好奇。我会再喝。

lines.en: Curious is interesting. So the bitterness isn't a reject signal here?
lines.zh: “好奇”这个点有意思。所以这里的苦并不是拒绝信号？

lines.en: No, it feels intentional. Like the product knows what it's doing.
lines.zh: 不是，它感觉是刻意的。像产品心里有数。

keys.en: first thing that came to mind

dialogs.title: Ordering at a Café
dialogs.goal: 掌握点单、定制规格、堂食外带与确认等待时间的日常高频表达。

lines.en: Hi! What can I get for you?
lines.zh: 您好！要点点什么？

lines.en: Could I get a medium flat white, please? With oat milk if you have it.
lines.zh: 麻烦来一杯中杯澳白，可以的话用燕麦奶。

lines.en: Sure — oat milk, medium flat white. Anything to eat?
lines.zh: 好的——燕麦奶，中杯澳白。要配点吃的吗？

lines.en: Maybe one of those almond croissants. Is it still warm?
lines.zh: 来一个那个杏仁可颂吧。现在还是热的吗？

lines.en: Just came out of the oven. Want it heated a little more?
lines.zh: 刚出炉。要再加热一下吗？

lines.en: That'd be great, thank you. And could I get that to stay, not takeaway?
lines.zh: 那太好了，谢谢。这杯我要堂食，不要外带。

lines.en: For here. Name for the cup?
lines.zh: 堂食。杯子写什么名字？

lines.en: It's Echo. How long should I expect to wait?
lines.zh: 写 Echo。大概要等多久？

lines.en: About four minutes — I'll bring it over to your table.
lines.zh: 大概四分钟——我给你送到座位上。

lines.en: Perfect, thanks so much.
lines.zh: 太好了，非常感谢。

dialogs.title: Negotiating a Specification With a Supplier
dialogs.zhTitle: 与供应商谈一份感官规格
dialogs.goal: 练习就感官规格、批次公差与交付节奏与供应商沟通，守住品质底线。

lines.en: So you want the sweetness capped at level 3 on your scale?
lines.zh: 所以你们希望甜度上限压在你们量表的 3 级？

lines.en: Level 3, and critically — no more than a half-step variance between batches.
lines.zh: 3 级，而且关键是——批次之间波动不能超过半级。

lines.en: Half a step is tight. That means we re-calibrate the line every run.
lines.zh: 半级很紧。那意味着每批我们都要重新校准产线。

lines.en: I understand the cost. But the consumer test showed anything above 3.5 drops purchase intent.
lines.zh: 成本我理解。但消费者测试显示，超过 3.5 购买意向就掉。

lines.en: Fair. What if we hold 3.0 to 3.3 and flag anything outside?
lines.zh: 合理。那我们控制在 3.0 到 3.3，超出的做标记，行吗？

lines.en: That works, as long as the flag triggers a hold, not a shipment.
lines.zh: 可以，前提是标记触发的是“扣留”，不是“发货”。

lines.en: Agreed — out-of-band goes to quarantine, not the truck.
lines.zh: 同意——超范围的进待检区，不上车。

lines.en: And lead time? We can't promise the same volume if batches fail.
lines.zh: 那交期呢？如果批次出问题，我们给不了同样产量。

lines.en: We'll build in a 10% buffer stock. You get first refusal on it.
lines.zh: 我们会留 10% 缓冲库存。你们有优先调配权。

lines.en: Good. Let's put the tolerance in writing before pilot.
lines.zh: 好。试点前我们把公差写进合同。

dialogs.title: Getting Directions on the Street
dialogs.goal: 掌握问路、确认距离、交通方式切换与表达感谢的实用句型。

lines.en: Excuse me, is the metro station far from here?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，地铁站离这儿远吗？

lines.en: Which one? There are two within walking distance.
lines.zh: 哪个站？步行范围内有两个。

lines.en: The one near the museum — line 4, I think.
lines.zh: 博物馆旁边那个——应该是 4 号线。

lines.en: That's about a ten-minute walk, straight down this street, then left at the church.
lines.zh: 走过去大概十分钟，沿这条街一直走，到教堂左转。

lines.en: Straight, then left at the church. And is it signposted?
lines.zh: 一直走，教堂左转。那儿有路牌指示吗？

lines.en: Mostly. But the sign's small — look up, not at the shops.
lines.zh: 基本有。但牌子小——抬头看，别盯店铺。

lines.en: Got it. Could I take a bus instead, if I get lost?
lines.zh: 明白了。万一迷路，我能坐公交吗？

lines.en: Bus 11 stops right there. But walking's quicker at this hour.
lines.zh: 11 路公交就在那儿停。不过这会儿走路更快。

lines.en: Perfect, I'll walk. Thank you, you saved me.
lines.zh: 太好了，我走过去。谢谢你，帮了大忙。

lines.en: No problem — enjoy the museum.
lines.zh: 不客气——博物馆好好玩。

dialogs.title: Scheduling a Meeting by Email
dialogs.goal: 练习礼貌提议时间、协调多人日程、提前同步议程与跟进。

lines.en: Hi Mark, hoping to sync on the Q3 research plan — do you have 30 minutes next week?
lines.zh: Mark 你好，想就三季度研究计划对齐一下——下周你有 30 分钟吗？

lines.en: Wednesday looks open. Morning your time?
lines.zh: 周三好像有空。你那边上午？

lines.en: Wednesday 10am works. Should we include Lena from insights?
lines.zh: 周三上午十点可以。要把洞察部的 Lena 也拉上吗？

lines.en: Yes, she owns the consumer data. Send the invite and I'll add her.
lines.zh: 要，消费数据是她负责的。你发邀约，我来加她。

lines.en: Done. I'll share the agenda beforehand so we don't wander.
lines.zh: 发了。我会提前发议程，免得跑题。

lines.en: Please do — last time we spent 20 minutes on the wrong slide.
lines.zh: 务必——上次我们拿错幻灯片耗了 20 分钟。

lines.en: Noted. I'll keep it to three points: scope, timeline, owners.
lines.zh: 记下了。我控制三个点：范围、时间线、责任人。

lines.en: That's the Mark I like. Anything you need from me before?
lines.zh: 这才对味。会前你需要我做什么？

lines.en: Just your take on the budget ceiling. I don't want to over-promise.
lines.zh: 就你对预算上限的看法。我不想过度承诺。

lines.en: I'll send a one-liner by Tuesday. Talk Wednesday.
lines.zh: 周二前我发一句话给你。周三聊。
